script:
import gzip,hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
root=Path.cwd();d=root/'docs/task042_neural_coarse_inverse';r=d/'outcomes/records';base='9a5434f23b78b16b7f8d7d56872eaec770204540';version=44
report=d/f'review_report_v{version}.md';record=r/f'review_v{version}_documentation_checks.json';record.write_text('{}\n')
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def git(*a):return subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','gc.auto=0','-c','maintenance.auto=false',*a])
assert report.name==f'review_report_v{version}.md';assert report.read_text().startswith(f'# Review V{version}：')
old=git('show',base+':docs/task042_neural_coarse_inverse/README.md');assert (d/'README.md').read_bytes().endswith(old)
checked=[]
for p in (report,d/'review_report_v43.md'):
 if p!=report:assert p.read_bytes()==git('show',base+':'+str(p.relative_to(root)))
 tables=[];links=[];fences=[];inside=False;width=None
 for i,line in enumerate(p.read_text().splitlines(),1):
  assert not any(ord(c)<32 and c!='\t' for c in line),(p,i)
  if line.startswith('```'):inside=not inside;fences.append(dict(line=i,value=line));continue
  if inside:continue
  assert '$$' not in line and '\\[' not in line and '\\]' not in line,(p,i)
  if line.startswith('|'):
   count=len(re.split(r'(?<!\\)\|',line))-2
   if width is None:tables.append(dict(line=i,columns=count));width=count
   assert count==width,(p,i,count,width)
  else:width=None
  for label,url in re.findall(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)',line):
   if url.startswith(('https://','http://')):continue
   assert (p.parent/url.split('#')[0]).resolve().exists(),(p,i,url)
   links.append(dict(line=i,path=url))
 assert not inside
 checked.append(dict(path=str(p.relative_to(root)),name=p.name,sha256=sha(p.read_bytes()),bytes=p.stat().st_size,tables=tables,local_links=links,math_fences=fences))
assert checked[0]['name']=='review_report_v44.md' and checked[1]['name']=='review_report_v43.md'
started=time.perf_counter();t=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','-q','src.test.test_26_documentation_contract'],capture_output=True,text=True);elapsed=time.perf_counter()-started;assert t.returncode==0,t.stdout+t.stderr
git('diff','--check');assert not git('diff','--name-only','--','src','benchmarks','scripts','input')
archives=[]
for source,name in [(root/'tmp/task042/review_v44/repository_index.json','review_v44_repository_index.gz'),(Path('/tmp/task042_review44_audit.py'),'review_v44_metadata_audit.py.gz')]:
 b=(r/name).read_bytes();raw=gzip.decompress(b);assert raw==source.read_bytes();archives.append(dict(path=name,sha256=sha(b),raw_sha256=sha(raw),raw_bytes=len(raw)))
out=dict(schema='task042.review44.docs.v1',UTC=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),reviewed_HEAD=base,expected_report='review_report_v44.md',actual_report=checked[0]['name'],files=checked,historical_review43_unchanged=True,README=dict(path=str((d/'README.md').relative_to(root)),sha256=sha((d/'README.md').read_bytes()),old_suffix_sha256=sha(old),old_suffix_preserved=True),review_archive_hashes=archives,unittest=dict(command='python -m unittest -q src.test.test_26_documentation_contract',returncode=t.returncode,stdout=t.stdout,stderr=t.stderr,elapsed_seconds=elapsed,scope='pure stdlib documentation only, no FE'),diff_check='PASS',source_edits=False,GitHub_visual='NOT_VERIFIED_CACHE_MISS',CI='NOT_RUN',script=Path(__file__).read_text())
record.write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(actual_reports=[c['name'] for c in checked],table_counts=[len(c['tables']) for c in checked],links=[len(c['local_links']) for c in checked],tests=t.stderr.strip(),diff_check='PASS'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
